what: The Quest capture Mac has an on-demand ht-rejoin command for updating the shared XR editor.
why: People can check incoming work and whether the running editor needs to reload. A fast-forward with only dashboard or documentation changes can keep the headset session open.
details: ht-rejoin --check passed with the editor running. The Mac native plugin build and cache reuse were verified separately. The new command has not yet performed a live relaunch.
